title: WorldForge V2: Eliciting Camera-Trajectory Alignment in Video Diffusion Models
title_zh: WorldForge V2：在视频扩散模型中引出相机轨迹对齐

paragraphs.en: Video diffusion models have learned rich 3D/4D priors, making them promising for scene generation and video re-rendering. However, their use in these spatial tasks is limited by imprecise camera control, spatial and temporal inconsistencies, and the entanglement of camera motion with scene dynamics. Existing approaches, such as task-specific fine-tuning and post-process warping, often introduce visual artifacts, generalize poorly, or incur high computational costs. We propose WorldForge V2, which aims to achieve accurate camera control while preserving the generative capabilities of pretrained video models. We first develop a training-free guidance framework using warped references to iteratively refine generation along a target camera path. Optical-flow analysis identifies motion-related latent channels for selective guidance, helping separate motion control from appearance. A dual-path strategy further compares guided and unguided predictions to correct artifacts from imperfect references. Together, these components guide viewpoint changes while preserving scene appearance and object motion. To reduce refinement costs, v-cache approximates the correction using the preceding denoising prediction, avoiding an additional model evaluation. We further extend motion localization from latent channels to network blocks and introduce Trajectory LoRA, which concentrates adaptation on blocks most responsive to trajectory guidance. A two-stage training strategy teaches these adapters to denoise the states encountered during guided generation, using limited supervision effectively. This enables reliable camera control with very little training data, with a single training scene already supporting generalization to unseen scenes. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations across multiple datasets show that our method achieves state-of-the-art generation quality and trajectory accuracy in camera-controlled video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 视频扩散模型已经学习到丰富的3D/4D先验，使其在场景生成和视频重渲染方面具有广阔前景。 然而，它们在这些空间任务中的应用受到相机控制不精确、时空不一致性以及相机运动与场景动态相互纠缠的限制。 现有方法（如任务特定的微调和后处理扭曲）往往会引入视觉伪影、泛化能力差或带来高昂的计算成本。 我们提出WorldForge V2，旨在实现精确的相机控制，同时保留预训练视频模型的生成能力。 我们首先开发了一个无需训练的引导框架，利用扭曲参考沿目标相机路径迭代地细化生成结果。 光流分析识别出与运动相关的潜在通道以进行选择性引导，帮助将运动控制与外观分离。 双路径策略进一步比较有引导和无引导的预测，以纠正不完美参考带来的伪影。 这些组件共同引导视角变化，同时保留场景外观和物体运动。 为了降低细化成本，v-cache利用前一步去噪预测来近似校正，避免了额外的模型评估。 我们进一步将运动定位从潜在通道扩展到网络模块，并引入Trajectory LoRA，将适配集中在对应轨迹引导最敏感的模块上。 两阶段训练策略教会这些适配器对引导生成过程中遇到的状态进行去噪，有效利用有限的监督。 这使得只需极少的训练数据即可实现可靠的相机控制，单个训练场景即可支持对未见场景的泛化。 在多个数据集上的定量和定性评估表明，我们的方法在相机控制的视频生成中实现了最先进的生成质量和轨迹精度。

paragraphs.en: Recent video diffusion models (VDMs) can synthesize videos with coherent motion, consistent scene content, and plausible viewpoint changes over time [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . Trained on large-scale video data, these models acquire strong spatiotemporal priors, making them powerful backbones for spatial-intelligence tasks such as 3D/4D generation, video re-rendering, and world modeling [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 ] . In these applications, the camera trajectory determines how a scene is observed over time, which regions become visible, and how viewpoint changes relate to scene geometry. Effective trajectory control is therefore essential. The generated video should follow a specified camera path while preserving scene content, object motion, temporal coherence, and visual quality.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的视频扩散模型（VDM）能够合成具有连贯运动、一致场景内容以及合理视角变化的视频 [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] 。 这些模型在大规模视频数据上训练，获得了强大的时空先验，使其成为 3D/4D 生成、视频重渲染和世界建模等空间智能任务的强大骨干网络 [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 ] 。 在这些应用中，相机轨迹决定了场景随时间被观察的方式、哪些区域会变得可见，以及视角变化与场景几何之间的关系。 因此，有效的轨迹控制至关重要。 生成的视频应遵循指定的相机路径，同时保持场景内容、物体运动、时间连贯性和视觉质量。

sents.en: Recent video diffusion models (VDMs) can synthesize videos with coherent motion, consistent scene content, and plausible viewpoint changes over time [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] .
sents.zh: 近期的视频扩散模型（VDM）能够合成具有连贯运动、一致场景内容以及合理视角变化的视频 [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] 。

sents.zh: 因此，有效的轨迹控制至关重要。

sents.zh: 生成的视频应遵循指定的相机路径，同时保持场景内容、物体运动、时间连贯性和视觉质量。

paragraphs.en: To realize such control, existing approaches broadly follow two directions. One direction adapts VDMs for camera control through additional trainable modules, pose-aware conditioning interfaces, or model fine-tuning [ 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 , 5 , 16 ] . These methods provide explicit camera control but often require large-scale trajectory–video supervision or careful fine-tuning. With limited supervision, such adaptation may weaken the visual and temporal priors of the pretrained model. Recent work has therefore explored training-free alternatives that keep the pretrained VDM fixed and inject trajectory cues only during inference [ 6 , 17 ] , including the zero-shot variant of Warp-as-History [ 18 ] . A representative route is warping-and-repainting , which warps already observed content along the target camera path and uses the pretrained video model to synthesize newly revealed regions. This route enables direct camera control at inference time while preserving the pretrained model, making it well suited to downstream spatial-intelligence tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 为实现这种控制，现有方法大致遵循两个方向。 一个方向是通过额外的可训练模块、位姿感知的条件接口或模型微调来改造 VDM 以实现相机控制 [ 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 , 5 , 16 ] 。 这些方法提供了显式的相机控制，但往往需要大规模的轨迹—视频监督或精细的微调。 在监督有限的情况下，这类改造可能削弱预训练模型的视觉与时序先验。 因此，近期工作探索了免训练的替代方案，即保持预训练 VDM 固定不变，仅在推理阶段注入轨迹线索 [ 6 , 17 ] ，包括 Warp-as-History 的零样本变体 [ 18 ] 。 一条代表性路线是扭曲—重绘，即沿目标相机路径扭曲已观测到的内容，并利用预训练视频模型来合成新显露的区域。 这一路线能够在推理时实现直接的相机控制，同时保留预训练模型，因此非常适于下游的空间智能任务。

sents.zh: 为实现这种控制，现有方法大致遵循两个方向。

sents.en: This route enables direct camera control at inference time while preserving the pretrained model, making it well suited to downstream spatial-intelligence tasks.
sents.zh: 这一路线能够在推理时实现直接的相机控制，同时保留预训练模型，因此非常适于下游的空间智能任务。

paragraphs.en: Despite these advantages, warping-and-repainting can introduce a denoising-state mismatch during diffusion sampling. When warped visible regions are directly combined with model-generated regions in a noisy latent, the two parts may correspond to different noise states. The warped regions are associated with externally sampled noise, whereas the generated regions follow the model’s own denoising trajectory. We refer to this mismatch as a denoising-state domain gap . It can lead to boundary discontinuities, geometric artifacts, noisy patches, and texture degradation. The key challenge is therefore to inject useful trajectory evidence from warped references while reducing the denoising-state gap introduced by their fusion.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管有这些优势，扭曲重绘方法在扩散采样过程中可能引入去噪状态不匹配的问题。 当被扭曲的可见区域与模型生成的区域在带噪潜变量中直接组合时，这两部分可能对应不同的噪声状态。 被扭曲的区域关联着外部采样的噪声，而生成的区域则遵循模型自身的去噪轨迹。 我们将这种不匹配称为去噪状态域差距。 它可能导致边界不连续、几何伪影、噪声斑块以及纹理退化。 因此，关键挑战在于从扭曲的参考中注入有用的轨迹证据，同时降低其融合所引入的去噪状态差距。

sents.zh: 尽管有这些优势，扭曲重绘方法在扩散采样过程中可能引入去噪状态不匹配的问题。

sents.zh: 我们将这种不匹配称为去噪状态域差距。

sents.zh: 它可能导致边界不连续、几何伪影、噪声斑块以及纹理退化。

sents.zh: 因此，关键挑战在于从扭曲的参考中注入有用的轨迹证据，同时降低其融合所引入的去噪状态差距。

paragraphs.en: To address this problem, we propose WorldForge V2 , a camera-trajectory-control framework that helps VDMs use imperfect warped trajectory signals more effectively while preserving generation quality. WorldForge V2 follows the warping-and-repainting route. First, it addresses the incompatibility introduced by warped-reference fusion: direct fusion in noisy latents mixes externally noised warped regions with generated regions following the model’s current denoising state. WorldForge V2 reduces this mismatch by fusing the warped reference into the model-predicted clean estimate and mapping the fused result back to the current denoising state, enabling training-free trajectory-aligned video generation. Second, clean-estimate fusion provides a reliable way to inject warped references into the denoising process by reducing noisy-state mismatch. To further improve its sampling efficiency, we introduce v-cache, which approximates the clean-estimate correction directly in noisy latents. In this way, warped-reference guidance can retain the benefit of clean-estimate fusion while reducing the extra sampling overhead. Finally, full-model fine-tuning and large trainable control modules involve optimizing a large number of parameters, making it difficult to use limited training data efficiently. To address this problem, we build on our pipeline and further investigate an optimization-based approach to camera-trajectory control. Since different layers in VDMs specialize in different functions, we extend the motion-channel localization used in FLF to model adaptation. We identify trajectory-sensitive blocks and apply LoRA only to these blocks. This selective adaptation provides a data-efficient alternative to broad model tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 WorldForge V2，这是一个相机轨迹控制框架，帮助视频扩散模型（VDM）更有效地利用不完美的扭曲轨迹信号，同时保持生成质量。 WorldForge V2 遵循扭曲-重绘路线。 首先，它解决了扭曲参考融合引入的不兼容问题：在噪声潜变量中的直接融合会将经过外部加噪的扭曲区域与遵循模型当前去噪状态的生成区域混合在一起。 WorldForge V2 通过将扭曲参考融合到模型预测的干净估计中，并将融合结果映射回当前去噪状态，来减小这种不匹配，从而实现无需训练的轨迹对齐视频生成。 其次，干净估计融合通过减少噪声状态不匹配，为将扭曲参考注入去噪过程提供了一种可靠的方式。 为了进一步提高采样效率，我们引入了 v-cache，它直接在噪声潜变量中近似干净估计校正。 这样，扭曲参考引导在保留干净估计融合优点的同时，减少了额外的采样开销。 最后，全模型微调和大型可训练控制模块需要优化大量参数，导致难以高效利用有限的训练数据。 为解决这一问题，我们在已有流程的基础上，进一步研究一种基于优化的相机轨迹控制方法。 由于视频扩散模型（VDM）中的不同层承担不同的功能，我们将 FLF 中使用的运动通道定位方法扩展到模型适配中。 我们识别对轨迹敏感的模块块，并仅在这些模块块上应用 LoRA。 这种选择性适配为大规模模型调优提供了一种数据高效的替代方案。

sents.zh: 这种选择性适配为大规模模型调优提供了一种数据高效的替代方案。

paragraphs.en: First, we address the denoising-state incompatibility caused by warped-reference fusion. In direct noisy-space fusion, the warped visible regions and the model-generated regions may follow different denoising states, causing geometric artifacts, boundary discontinuities, and noisy patches. To mitigate this mismatch, Intra-Step Recursive Refinement (IRR) fuses the warped reference with the model-predicted clean estimate under the visibility mask and then re-noises the fused estimate to the current timestep. This fuse-then-renoise process associates all regions with the same Gaussian noise realization, thereby reducing their denoising-state gap. Camera-trajectory control also faces a typical motion–appearance disentanglement problem, as enforcing camera motion may inadvertently alter object and scene appearance. To address this problem, Flow-Gated Latent Fusion (FLF) uses optical-flow cues to locate channels that are highly correlated with motion and injects trajectory guidance only into these channels, thereby reducing appearance distortion. Finally, artifacts or misalignment in the warped reference may degrade the quality of the generated video. To mitigate this issue, we propose Dual-Path Self-Corrective Guidance (DSG). Inspired by classifier-free guidance [ 19 ] , DSG compares the trajectory-guided and unguided denoising directions. Their difference captures the update introduced by trajectory guidance, which DSG uses to suppress unreliable deviations while retaining useful trajectory constraints. Together, IRR, FLF, and DSG enable training-free trajectory-aligned video generation while reducing the adverse effects of incompatible denoising states and unreliable reference signals.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，我们解决由 warped-reference 融合导致的去噪状态不兼容问题。 在直接进行噪声空间融合时，warped 可见区域与模型生成区域可能处于不同的去噪状态，从而引起几何伪影、边界不连续和噪声斑块。 为缓解这一不匹配，Intra-Step Recursive Refinement（IRR，步内递归精炼）在可见性掩码下将 warped 参考与模型预测的干净估计进行融合，然后将融合后的估计重新加噪至当前时间步。 这一「先融合再重新加噪」的过程使所有区域关联到同一高斯噪声实现，从而缩小它们的去噪状态差距。 相机轨迹控制还面临典型的运动—外观解耦问题，因为强制相机运动可能无意中改变物体和场景的外观。 为解决这一问题，Flow-Gated Latent Fusion（FLF，流门控潜空间融合）利用光流线索定位与运动高度相关的通道，并仅向这些通道注入轨迹引导，从而减少外观失真。 最后，warped 参考中的伪影或错位可能降低生成视频的质量。 为缓解这一问题，我们提出 Dual-Path Self-Corrective Guidance（DSG，双路径自纠正引导）。 受 classifier-free guidance [ 19 ] 的启发，DSG 比较有轨迹引导与无引导的去噪方向。 两者的差异捕捉了轨迹引导所引入的更新，DSG 利用这一差异抑制不可靠的偏差，同时保留有用的轨迹约束。 总体而言，IRR、FLF 和 DSG 共同实现了免训练的轨迹对齐视频生成，同时减少了不兼容去噪状态和不可靠参考信号带来的不良影响。

paragraphs.en: Second, the fuse-then-renoise process in IRR provides an effective way to reduce the denoising-state gap introduced by warped-reference fusion. We further improve the efficiency of this process with v-cache. Our key observation is that the correction induced by clean-estimate fusion can be approximated directly in noisy latent space from a denoising prediction already available during sampling. Based on this observation, v-cache applies the approximated correction during warped-reference fusion, allowing trajectory guidance to remain on the original denoising path. This avoids an additional model evaluation and reduces inference latency.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，IRR 中的先融合再加噪过程提供了一种有效方式，可以减小由扭曲参考融合引入的去噪状态差距。 我们进一步通过 v-cache 提升了这一过程的效率。 我们的关键观察是，干净估计融合所引入的校正可以直接在噪声潜空间中，从采样过程中已可获得的去噪预测来近似。 基于这一观察，v-cache 在扭曲参考融合时施加该近似校正，使轨迹引导保持在原始去噪路径上。 这避免了额外的模型评估，并降低了推理延迟。

paragraphs.en: Finally, we further develop an optimization-based extension of our pipeline for camera-trajectory control. Existing optimization-based methods often fine-tune the full model or introduce large trainable control modules, making inefficient use of limited supervision. Since camera control mainly depends on motion-related representations, we extend the motion-channel localization idea of FLF to model adaptation. Leveraging the functional specialization of different VDM layers [ 20 ] , we identify trajectory-sensitive blocks, apply LoRA only to these blocks, and train the adapters with a two-stage optimization strategy tailored to our pipeline. This selective adaptation provides a data-efficient alternative to broad model tuning. In our experiments, we find that training data from a single scene is sufficient to enable effective trajectory following.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，我们进一步开发了基于优化的流水线扩展，用于相机轨迹控制。 现有的基于优化的方法通常需要对完整模型进行微调，或引入大型可训练控制模块，导致对有限监督的低效利用。 由于相机控制主要依赖于与运动相关的表征，我们将 FLF 的运动通道定位思路扩展到模型适配中。 利用不同 VDM 层的功能特化性 [20]，我们识别出对轨迹敏感的模块，仅在这些模块上应用 LoRA，并采用为我们的流水线量身定制的两阶段优化策略来训练适配器。 这种选择性适配提供了一种数据高效的方式，可替代大范围模型调优。 在我们的实验中，我们发现来自单一场景的训练数据就足以实现有效的轨迹跟随。

paragraphs.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: To address denoising-state mismatch, motion–appearance entanglement, and unreliable warped references, we develop a training-free guidance pipeline with IRR, FLF, and DSG, enabling trajectory-aligned video generation with fewer artifacts and less appearance distortion.
paragraphs.zh: 为解决去噪状态不匹配、运动–外观纠缠以及不可靠的扭曲参考等问题，我们开发了一种无需训练的引导管线，包含 IRR、FLF 和 DSG，实现了轨迹对齐的视频生成，同时减少了伪影和外观失真。

paragraphs.en: To retain the benefit of clean-estimate correction with lower sampling cost, we introduce v-cache, which approximates the correction in noisy latent space and avoids an additional model evaluation, thereby reducing inference latency.
paragraphs.zh: 为了以更低的采样成本保留干净估计校正的收益，我们引入了 v-cache，它在带噪潜空间中近似这种校正，并避免了额外的模型评估，从而降低了推理延迟。

paragraphs.en: To avoid data-inefficient full-model tuning, we identify trajectory-sensitive blocks, adapt only these blocks with LoRA, and optimize them using a two-stage strategy tailored to our pipeline; training data from a single scene is sufficient to enable effective trajectory following.
paragraphs.zh: 为避免数据效率低下的全模型微调，我们识别对轨迹敏感的模块，仅使用 LoRA 对这些模块进行适配，并采用适合我们流程的两阶段策略对其进行优化；来自单一场景的训练数据便足以实现有效的轨迹跟随。

paragraphs.en: Comparative experiments on multiple public datasets demonstrate accurate camera-path control and high-quality video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 在多个公开数据集上的对比实验表明，该方法能够实现精确的相机路径控制与高质量的视频生成。

paragraphs.en: We review four lines of work closely related to WorldForge V2: video diffusion priors for spatial generation, camera control in video diffusion models, guidance and correction strategies in generative models, and parameter-efficient adaptation for camera control.
paragraphs.zh: 我们回顾了与 WorldForge V2 密切相关的四个研究方向：用于空间生成的视频扩散先验、视频扩散模型中的相机控制、生成模型中的引导与纠正策略，以及面向相机控制的参数高效适配。

paragraphs.en: Video diffusion models (VDMs) learn rich priors of real-world appearance, motion, temporal continuity, and viewpoint change from large-scale video data [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 22 ] . Recent studies have transferred these priors to spatial generation tasks, including 3D/4D scene generation, novel-view video synthesis, and world modeling [ 23 , 24 , 4 , 5 , 6 , 14 , 25 , 8 , 10 , 9 , 26 , 27 , 28 , 29 , 30 ] . This scene-level use of video priors complements explicit scene reconstruction based on NeRFs, Gaussian splatting, multi-view and light-field synthesis [ 31 , 32 , 33 , 34 , 35 , 36 , 37 ] , as well as scene generation from panoramic images [ 38 ] and object-centric 3D generation based on diffusion models [ 39 , 40 , 41 , 42 , 43 ] . While reconstruction methods recover scene structure from observed views, VDMs can use their learned priors to generate plausible content beyond the observed regions. However, VDM pretraining does not explicitly align camera trajectories with scene content. As a result, these models can generate high-quality videos but cannot reliably follow a prescribed camera path, motivating growing research on trajectory-controlled video generation. WorldForge V2 combines warped geometric evidence with the generative prior of a pretrained VDM to control viewpoint changes.
paragraphs.zh: 视频扩散模型（VDM）从大规模视频数据中学习真实世界的外观、运动、时间连续性以及视角变化的丰富先验 [1, 2, 3, 22]。 近期的研究已将这些先验迁移到空间生成任务中，包括 3D/4D 场景生成、新视角视频合成以及世界建模 [23, 24, 4, 5, 6, 14, 25, 8, 10, 9, 26, 27, 28, 29, 30]。 这种对视频先验的场景级应用，补充了基于 NeRF、高斯泼溅、多视角和光场合成的显式场景重建 [31, 32, 33, 34, 35, 36, 37]，以及基于全景图像的场景生成 [38] 和基于扩散模型的以物体为中心的 3D 生成 [39, 40, 41, 42, 43]。 重建方法从观测到的视角恢复场景结构，而 VDM 则可以利用其学到的先验，生成观测区域之外看似合理的内容。 然而，VDM 的预训练并未将相机轨迹与场景内容显式对齐。 因此，这些模型能够生成高质量的视频，却无法可靠地遵循指定的相机路径，这推动了轨迹控制视频生成研究的不断增长。 WorldForge V2 将扭曲的几何证据与预训练 VDM 的生成先验相结合，以控制视角变化。

paragraphs.en: Existing camera-control methods broadly follow two directions. Training-based methods introduce pose-aware conditioning interfaces, additional control modules, or model fine-tuning to learn camera-controlled generation [ 12 , 13 , 15 , 14 , 5 , 44 , 16 , 45 ] . These methods provide explicit camera control but usually require substantial trajectory–video supervision; when training data are limited, model adaptation may weaken the visual and temporal priors learned during pretraining. Recent work has therefore increasingly explored training-free inference-time control and lightweight adaptation, which preserve most or all of the pretrained model and inject trajectory cues through initial noise, latent transformations, rendered references, or history frames [ 8 , 6 , 17 , 46 , 47 , 18 , 48 ] . Across training-based and training-free methods, warping-and-repainting warps observed content along the target camera path and uses a VDM to generate newly revealed regions [ 49 , 50 ] . This route provides explicit geometric correspondence and integrates naturally with depth estimation, point-based rendering, and visibility masks. WorldForge V2 adopts this route and studies how warped references can be used more effectively for camera-trajectory control while reducing the artifacts introduced during denoising. Related motion-control work also uses entity-specific 3D trajectories to control object motion [ 51 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 现有的相机控制方法大致遵循两条方向。 基于训练的方法引入姿态感知的条件接口、额外的控制模块或模型微调来学习相机控制的生成 [ 12 , 13 , 15 , 14 , 5 , 44 , 16 , 45 ] 。 这些方法提供了显式的相机控制，但通常需要大量的轨迹—视频监督；当训练数据有限时，模型适配可能会削弱预训练期间学到的视觉与时间先验。 因此，近期工作越来越多地探索免训练的推理时控制与轻量级适配，这类方法保留预训练模型的大部分或全部参数，并通过初始噪声、潜变量变换、渲染参考或历史帧来注入轨迹线索 [ 8 , 6 , 17 , 46 , 47 , 18 , 48 ] 。 在基于训练与免训练的方法中， warp-and-repaint （扭曲重绘）路线沿目标相机路径扭曲已观测内容，并使用视频扩散模型（VDM）生成新显现的区域 [ 49 , 50 ] 。 这一路线提供显式的几何对应关系，并自然地与深度估计、基于点的渲染以及可见性掩码相融合。 WorldForge V2 采用这一路线，研究如何更有效地利用扭曲后的参考来实现相机轨迹控制，同时减少去噪过程中引入的伪影。 相关的运动控制工作还使用实体特定的 3D 轨迹来控制物体运动 [ 51 ] 。

sents.en: Existing camera-control methods broadly follow two directions.
sents.zh: 现有的相机控制方法大致遵循两条方向。

sents.zh: 基于训练的方法引入姿态感知的条件接口、额外的控制模块或模型微调来学习相机控制的生成 [ 12 , 13 , 15 , 14 , 5 , 44 , 16 , 45 ] 。

sents.en: These methods provide explicit camera control but usually require substantial trajectory–video supervision; when training data are limited, model adaptation may weaken the visual and temporal priors learned during pretraining.
sents.zh: 这些方法提供了显式的相机控制，但通常需要大量的轨迹—视频监督；当训练数据有限时，模型适配可能会削弱预训练期间学到的视觉与时间先验。

sents.en: Recent work has therefore increasingly explored training-free inference-time control and lightweight adaptation, which preserve most or all of the pretrained model and inject trajectory cues through initial noise, latent transformations, rendered references, or history frames [ 8 , 6 , 17 , 46 , 47 , 18 , 48 ] .
sents.zh: 因此，近期工作越来越多地探索免训练的推理时控制与轻量级适配，这类方法保留预训练模型的大部分或全部参数，并通过初始噪声、潜变量变换、渲染参考或历史帧来注入轨迹线索 [ 8 , 6 , 17 , 46 , 47 , 18 , 48 ] 。

sents.en: Across training-based and training-free methods, warping-and-repainting warps observed content along the target camera path and uses a VDM to generate newly revealed regions [ 49 , 50 ] .
sents.zh: 在基于训练与免训练的方法中， warp-and-repaint （扭曲重绘）路线沿目标相机路径扭曲已观测内容，并使用视频扩散模型（VDM）生成新显现的区域 [ 49 , 50 ] 。

sents.en: This route provides explicit geometric correspondence and integrates naturally with depth estimation, point-based rendering, and visibility masks.
sents.zh: 这一路线提供显式的几何对应关系，并自然地与深度估计、基于点的渲染以及可见性掩码相融合。

sents.en: WorldForge V2 adopts this route and studies how warped references can be used more effectively for camera-trajectory control while reducing the artifacts introduced during denoising.
sents.zh: WorldForge V2 采用这一路线，研究如何更有效地利用扭曲后的参考来实现相机轨迹控制，同时减少去噪过程中引入的伪影。

sents.en: Related motion-control work also uses entity-specific 3D trajectories to control object motion [ 51 ] .
sents.zh: 相关的运动控制工作还使用实体特定的 3D 轨迹来控制物体运动 [ 51 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Guidance methods steer diffusion or flow models toward desired outputs by modifying their sampling directions. Classifier-free guidance (CFG) combines conditional and unconditional predictions to improve alignment with semantic conditions [ 19 ] . Subsequent methods further adjust the guidance direction through negative or auxiliary branches, differential predictions, adaptive rescaling, resampling, and iterative repainting [ 52 , 53 , 54 , 55 , 56 , 57 , 58 ] . In 3D/4D generation, guidance is also widely used to enforce viewpoint consistency from rendered or warped observations [ 59 , 60 , 6 , 17 , 8 ] . However, conventional guidance does not directly address the artifacts introduced by noisy warped references. WorldForge V2 explores correction strategies for warping-guided generation, including correcting warped-reference fusion in noisy latent space and using the difference between guided and unguided predictions to refine the denoising process. Together, these strategies improve the quality of trajectory-controlled videos generated under warping guidance.
paragraphs.zh: 引导方法通过修改扩散模型或流模型的采样方向，使其朝着期望的输出方向生成。 无分类器引导（CFG）通过结合条件预测与无条件预测来提升与语义条件的一致性 [ 19 ] 。 后续方法进一步通过负向或辅助分支、差分预测、自适应缩放、重采样以及迭代重绘来调整引导方向 [ 52 , 53 , 54 , 55 , 56 , 57 , 58 ] 。 在 3D/4D 生成中，引导也被广泛用于从渲染或扭曲的观测中强制视角一致性 [ 59 , 60 , 6 , 17 , 8 ] 。 然而，传统引导方法并未直接处理带噪扭曲参考所引入的伪影。 WorldForge V2 探索了针对扭曲引导生成的校正策略，包括在带噪潜空间中校正扭曲参考的融合，以及利用有引导预测与无引导预测之间的差异来改进去噪过程。 这些策略共同提升了在扭曲引导下生成的轨迹控制视频的质量。

paragraphs.en: Model adaptation commonly uses trainable control branches or parameter-efficient fine-tuning. ControlNet and T2I-Adapter introduce lightweight conditioning modules, while LoRA adapts pretrained models through low-rank parameter updates [ 61 , 62 , 63 ] . These lightweight adaptation strategies have also been applied to motion learning, sparse-view synthesis, and trajectory-controlled generation with limited training data [ 64 , 65 , 18 , 45 ] . Related studies further show that motion- and camera-related representations are concentrated in particular latent channels or network layers [ 20 , 66 ] . Based on these findings, WorldForge V2 uses optical-flow cues in FLF to localize motion-related latent channels and reduce appearance interference. We further extend this idea to model adaptation by identifying trajectory-sensitive blocks and applying lightweight LoRA only to these blocks, enabling effective trajectory alignment with very limited training data.
paragraphs.zh: 模型适配通常使用可训练的控制分支或参数高效微调。 ControlNet 和 T2I-Adapter 引入了轻量级的条件控制模块，而 LoRA 则通过低秩参数更新来适配预训练模型 [ 61 , 62 , 63 ] 。 这些轻量级适配策略也已被应用于运动学习、稀疏视角合成以及仅用有限训练数据的轨迹控制生成 [ 64 , 65 , 18 , 45 ] 。 相关研究进一步表明，与运动和相机相关的表征集中在特定的潜在通道或网络层中 [ 20 , 66 ] 。 基于这些发现，WorldForge V2 在 FLF 中利用光流线索来定位与运动相关的潜在通道，并减少外观干扰。 我们进一步将这一思路扩展到模型适配中，通过识别对轨迹敏感的模块并仅对这些模块应用轻量级 LoRA，从而在极有限的训练数据下实现有效的轨迹对齐。

paragraphs.en: WorldForge V2 (Fig. 2 ) aims to control camera trajectories while preserving the video priors of pretrained generation models. Given a source image or video and a target camera path, geometric warping first produces a trajectory reference and its visibility mask. WorldForge V2 then uses these signals to guide denoising and generate videos that follow the target path. Sec. III-A introduces the required notation and background. Sec. III-B presents the training-free guidance pipeline: IRR reduces the denoising-state gap through clean-estimate fusion, FLF restricts trajectory injection to motion-related latent channels, and DSG corrects the guided prediction using the model’s original denoising path. Sec. III-C derives a noisy-latent correction that reduces the denoising-state gap with fewer model evaluations. Finally, Sec. III-D identifies trajectory-sensitive network blocks and adapts them with LoRA using limited supervision, enabling data-efficient trajectory control for VDMs.
paragraphs.zh: WorldForge V2（图2）旨在控制相机轨迹，同时保留预训练生成模型的视频先验。 给定一张源图像或视频以及目标相机路径，几何变形（geometric warping）首先生成轨迹参考及其可见性掩码。 WorldForge V2 随后利用这些信号来引导去噪，并生成遵循目标路径的视频。第 III-A 节介绍所需的记号与背景知识。第 III-B 节展示免训练引导流程：IRR 通过干净估计融合减小去噪状态差距，FLF 将轨迹注入限制在与运动相关的隐空间通道上，DSG 则利用模型原始的去噪路径对引导预测进行修正。第 III-C 节推导出一种噪声隐变量修正方法，能用更少的模型评估次数减小去噪状态差距。最后，第 III-D 节识别对轨迹敏感的网络模块，并使用有限监督通过 LoRA 对其进行适配，从而为视频扩散模型（VDM）实现数据高效的轨迹控制。

paragraphs.en: Geometric warping explicitly indicates how observed content should move along the target camera path. However, directly inserting the noised reference mixes the externally re-noised visible region with the model-generated region, producing a denoising-state gap that can cause noisy patches and structural errors. We therefore inject the reference through the model-predicted clean estimate and re-noise the fused result with a unified noise sample. We further restrict guidance to motion-related channels and calibrate the guided prediction against the model’s original denoising path. Together, these designs enable training-free trajectory control while preserving visual quality.
paragraphs.zh: 几何形变显式地指示了观测内容应如何沿目标相机路径移动。 然而，直接插入加噪的参考会将外部重新加噪的可见区域与模型生成的区域混合在一起，产生去噪状态差异，从而导致噪点斑块和结构错误。 因此，我们通过模型预测的干净估计来注入参考，并用统一的噪声样本对融合结果重新加噪。 我们进一步将引导限制在与运动相关的通道上，并将引导后的预测与模型原始的去噪路径进行校准。 这些设计共同实现了免训练的轨迹控制，同时保持了视觉质量。

paragraphs.en: Intra-Step Recursive Refinement (IRR). Direct noisy-latent insertion assigns newly sampled noise to the warped visible region while retaining the model’s current denoising state elsewhere. To avoid directly combining these incompatible states, IRR first fuses the warped reference in the model-predicted clean space and then re-noises the fused result with one Gaussian noise sample.
paragraphs.zh: 步内递归精细化（Intra-Step Recursive Refinement, IRR）。 直接噪声潜变量插入是在扭曲后的可见区域分配新采样的噪声，同时保留模型在其他位置的当前去噪状态。 为避免直接合并这些不兼容的状态，IRR 先在模型预测的干净空间中融合扭曲后的参考，然后用一个高斯噪声样本对融合结果重新加噪。

paragraphs.en: Flow-Gated Latent Fusion (FLF). Camera-trajectory control should separate camera-induced motion from object appearance and intrinsic motion. However, VAE channels encode different types of information, so replacing all channels with the same trajectory signal may also distort appearance. This channel specialization is supported by MOFT, which uses PCA to identify motion-related channels [ 20 ] . Based on this observation, FLF uses optical flow to select channels whose temporal motion agrees with the target trajectory, requiring no gradient-based optimization during inference.
paragraphs.zh: 流门控潜空间融合（FLF）。 相机轨迹控制应当将相机引发的运动与物体的外观及内在运动分离开来。 然而，VAE 的各通道编码了不同类型的信息，因此用相同的轨迹信号替换所有通道也可能扭曲外观。 这种通道专门化得到了 MOFT 的支持，该方法使用 PCA 来识别与运动相关的通道 [ 20 ] 。 基于这一观察，FLF 利用光流来选择其时间运动与目标轨迹一致的通道，且在推理过程中无需基于梯度的优化。

sents.zh: 这样，轨迹证据被注入到具有明确运动一致性的通道中，而其余通道继续遵循预训练模型，从而减少纹理和外观的失真。

paragraphs.en: Dual-Path Self-Corrective Guidance (DSG). Warped trajectory references may contain distortions caused by depth errors, occlusions, or misalignment, and these errors can degrade the generated video. Inspired by CFG and AutoGuidance [ 19 , 52 ] , DSG compares a trajectory-guided prediction with the model’s original prediction and uses their difference to refine the guidance, allowing the result to follow the trajectory constraint while improving visual quality.
paragraphs.zh: 双路径自校正引导（DSG）。 扭曲的轨迹参考可能包含由深度误差、遮挡或错位引起的畸变，这些误差会降低生成视频的质量。 受 CFG 和 AutoGuidance [19, 52] 的启发，DSG 将轨迹引导的预测与模型的原始预测进行比较，并利用二者的差异来改进引导，使结果在遵循轨迹约束的同时提升视觉质量。

paragraphs.en: Overall, IRR injects the warped reference through clean-estimate fusion, FLF restricts guidance to motion-related channels, and DSG calibrates the guided prediction using the base denoising path. Together, they enable training-free camera-trajectory control while preserving scene appearance and reducing artifacts from imperfect warped references.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，IRR 通过干净估计融合注入扭曲参考，FLF 将引导限制在运动相关通道上，DSG 则利用基础去噪路径校准引导后的预测。 二者结合实现了无需训练的相机轨迹控制，同时保留了场景外观，并减少了不完美扭曲参考带来的伪影。

paragraphs.en: The fuse-then-renoise process in IRR effectively reduces the denoising-state gap introduced by warped-reference fusion. Building on this, we further improve its sampling efficiency. IRR first evaluates the video model on the original latent to obtain the clean estimate and then evaluates the trajectory-guided latent to continue denoising. Our key observation is that the correction introduced by clean-estimate fusion can be written directly in noisy latent space. We therefore derive this correction and approximate it using the velocity cached from the preceding denoising step. This gives v-cache, a single-forward path for efficient trajectory guidance.
paragraphs.zh: IRR 中的先熔合再加噪过程有效减少了由 warped 参考熔合引入的去噪状态差距。 在此基础上，我们进一步提升了其采样效率。 IRR 首先在原始潜变量上评估视频模型以获得干净估计，然后在轨迹引导的潜变量上评估以继续去噪。 我们的关键观察是，由干净估计熔合引入的修正可以直接写在带噪潜变量空间中。 因此我们推导出该修正，并使用前一个去噪步骤缓存的物质速度对其进行近似。 由此得到 v-cache，一条用于高效轨迹引导的单次前向路径。

sents.zh: 因此，v-cache 在每个引导步骤中用一次模型评估来近似 IRR 校正。

sents.en: The experiments compare this approximation with the exact current-step correction in terms of noise statistics and generation quality.
sents.zh: 实验从噪声统计和生成质量两方面将这种近似与精确的当前步骤校正进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Optimization-based camera control often relies on full-model fine-tuning or large trainable modules, requiring substantial trajectory–video data and computation. With limited supervision, broad parameter updates may also weaken pretrained visual and spatiotemporal priors, causing degraded geometry or implausible structures. We therefore seek a data-efficient adaptation strategy that strengthens trajectory control with limited supervision while restricting parameter updates to preserve the pretrained priors.
paragraphs.zh: 基于优化的相机控制通常依赖于全模型微调或大型可训练模块，需要大量的轨迹–视频数据和计算资源。 在监督有限的情况下，大范围的参数更新还可能削弱预训练的视觉与时空先验，导致几何退化或结构不合理。 因此，我们寻求一种数据高效的适配策略，在有限监督下增强轨迹控制，同时限制参数更新以保留预训练先验。

paragraphs.en: Our method combines trajectory-sensitive block selection with v-cache-aligned LoRA training. FLF analyzes how motion and appearance features are distributed across latent channels; we extend this localization idea to network blocks and apply LoRA only to blocks that are sensitive to trajectory signals. We then inject trajectories through v-cache and train these adapters on latent states produced by v-cache guidance. This design concentrates limited supervision on trajectory-relevant components and enables data-efficient adaptation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法将轨迹敏感的块选择与 v-cache 对齐的 LoRA 训练相结合。 FLF 分析运动与外观特征在潜在通道上的分布方式；我们将这一局部化思想扩展到网络块，并仅对轨迹信号敏感的块应用 LoRA。 随后，我们通过 v-cache 注入轨迹，并在由 v-cache 引导生成的潜在状态上训练这些适配器。 这一设计将有限的监督集中在与轨迹相关的组件上，实现了数据高效的适配。

paragraphs.en: Trajectory-Supervised Data Construction. To construct paired trajectory references and target videos, we use the public DL3DV dataset [ 77 ] , which provides multi-view observations and optimized 3D Gaussian Splatting representations [ 32 ] . For each scene, we select multiple source views and sample several target camera paths for each view. The 3DGS representation provides the source-view depth and renders RGB frames along each target path.
paragraphs.zh: 轨迹监督的数据构建。 为了构建成对的轨迹参考与目标视频，我们使用公开的 DL3DV 数据集 [77]，该数据集提供多视角观测以及优化后的 3D 高斯溅射（3D Gaussian Splatting）表示 [32]。 对于每个场景，我们选取多个源视角，并为每个视角采样若干条目标相机路径。 3DGS 表示提供源视角的深度，并沿每条目标路径渲染 RGB 帧。

paragraphs.en: Trajectory-Sensitive Block Identification. Prior analyses suggest that motion-related responses are not uniformly distributed across video-model layers [ 20 , 66 ] . To identify blocks that are sensitive to trajectory control, we extend the motion–appearance localization idea of FLF from latent channels to network blocks. We treat all self-attention blocks as candidates and determine their sensitivity directly from their responses to trajectory supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 轨迹敏感的模块识别。 先前的分析表明，与运动相关的响应并非均匀分布于视频模型的各层中 [ 20 , 66 ] 。 为了识别对轨迹控制敏感的模块，我们将 FLF 的运动–外观定位思想从潜变量通道扩展到网络模块。 我们将所有自注意力模块视为候选，并直接根据它们对轨迹监督的响应来确定其敏感度。

paragraphs.en: Data-Efficient Trajectory LoRA Training. The final LoRA is used with v-cache, so its training inputs should reflect the states encountered during v-cache inference. Standard flow matching constructs inputs by independently noising the clean target. In contrast, a v-cache state also contains the warped reference, visibility mask, and cached inversion-noise correction. Training only on independently noised targets would therefore leave a gap between training and inference states.
paragraphs.zh: 数据高效的轨迹 LoRA 训练。 最终的 LoRA 与 v-cache 配合使用，因此其训练输入应能反映 v-cache 推理时所遇到的状态。 标准的流匹配通过独立地对干净目标加噪来构造输入。 相比之下，v-cache 状态还包含扭曲参考、可见性掩码以及缓存的反演噪声校正。 因此，仅在独立加噪的目标上进行训练，会造成训练状态与推理状态之间的差距。

sents.en: We then apply the same warped-reference insertion, visibility mask, and v-cache correction used during inference to obtain 𝐱 ~ σ d \tilde{\mathbf{x}}_{\sigma_{d}} .
sents.zh: 然后，我们应用与推理阶段相同的扭曲参考插入、可见性掩码以及 v-cache 校正，得到 𝐱 ~ σ d \tilde{\mathbf{x}}_{\sigma_{d}} 。

sents.en: This state preserves the structure of a v-cache input while extending training beyond the recorded anchor levels.
sents.zh: 该状态在保持 v-cache 输入结构的同时，将训练扩展到所记录锚点层级之外。

paragraphs.en: The first stage provides real v-cache states, while the second constructs aligned states at additional noise levels, reducing the training–inference gap and extending adaptation beyond the saved anchors. Detailed training settings are provided in the supplementary material. At inference, only the LoRA adapters in ℬ traj \mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{traj}} are loaded. Experiments show that training on one scene generalizes to unseen scenes. The trained LongCat adapter also transfers to other trajectory-injection methods without additional fine-tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 第一阶段提供真实的 v-cache 状态，而第二阶段在额外的噪声水平上构建对齐的状态，从而缩小训练与推理之间的差距，并将适配扩展到已保存的锚点之外。 详细的训练设置在补充材料中提供。 在推理时，只加载 ℬ traj \mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{traj}} 中的 LoRA 适配器。 实验表明，在一个场景上训练可以泛化到未见过的场景。 训练好的 LongCat 适配器还能迁移到其他轨迹注入方法，无需额外微调。

sents.en: The first stage provides real v-cache states, while the second constructs aligned states at additional noise levels, reducing the training–inference gap and extending adaptation beyond the saved anchors.
sents.zh: 第一阶段提供真实的 v-cache 状态，而第二阶段在额外的噪声水平上构建对齐的状态，从而缩小训练与推理之间的差距，并将适配扩展到已保存的锚点之外。

sents.en: At inference, only the LoRA adapters in ℬ traj \mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{traj}} are loaded.
sents.zh: 在推理时，只加载 ℬ traj \mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{traj}} 中的 LoRA 适配器。

sents.en: Experiments show that training on one scene generalizes to unseen scenes.
sents.zh: 实验表明，在一个场景上训练可以泛化到未见过的场景。

sents.en: The trained LongCat adapter also transfers to other trajectory-injection methods without additional fine-tuning.
sents.zh: 训练好的 LongCat 适配器还能迁移到其他轨迹注入方法，无需额外微调。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments examine how rendered-reference guidance combines camera control with the scene priors of pretrained video models. We first evaluate the training-free framework in static 3D generation and dynamic 4D re-rendering, then study V-Cache correction and data-efficient LoRA adaptation. Transfer experiments examine the reuse of the learned control, and ablations establish the roles of guidance, block selection, and training. We denote the IRR–FLF–DSG framework as Ours (Training-Free) and the adapted models as Ours (LongCat) and Ours (H3) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验考察了渲染参考引导如何将相机控制与预训练视频模型的场景先验相结合。 我们首先在静态3D生成和动态4D重渲染中评估免训练框架，然后研究 V-Cache 校正与数据高效的 LoRA 适配。 迁移实验考察了所学控制的复用，消融实验确立了引导、块选择和训练的作用。 我们将 IRR–FLF–DSG 框架记为 Ours (Training-Free)，将适配后的模型记为 Ours (LongCat) 和 Ours (H3)。

sents.en: Our experiments examine how rendered-reference guidance combines camera control with the scene priors of pretrained video models.
sents.zh: 我们的实验考察了渲染参考引导如何将相机控制与预训练视频模型的场景先验相结合。

sents.en: We first evaluate the training-free framework in static 3D generation and dynamic 4D re-rendering, then study V-Cache correction and data-efficient LoRA adaptation.
sents.zh: 我们首先在静态3D生成和动态4D重渲染中评估免训练框架，然后研究 V-Cache 校正与数据高效的 LoRA 适配。

sents.en: Transfer experiments examine the reuse of the learned control, and ablations establish the roles of guidance, block selection, and training.
sents.zh: 迁移实验考察了所学控制的复用，消融实验确立了引导、块选择和训练的作用。

sents.en: We denote the IRR–FLF–DSG framework as Ours (Training-Free) and the adapted models as Ours (LongCat) and Ours (H3) .
sents.zh: 我们将 IRR–FLF–DSG 框架记为 Ours (Training-Free)，将适配后的模型记为 Ours (LongCat) 和 Ours (H3)。

paragraphs.en: For training-free camera control, we use Wan2.1 I2V-14B [ 2 ] , with IRR applied during early denoising. We implement Trajectory LoRA on LongCat-Video [ 71 ] and MiniMax-H3 by adapting selected self-attention projections while keeping the pretrained weights fixed. Both models use anchor warm-up followed by training on guided latent states. Detailed training and inference settings are provided in the supplementary material.
paragraphs.zh: 对于免训练的相机控制，我们使用 Wan2.1 I2V-14B [ 2 ]，并在早期去噪阶段应用 IRR。 我们在 LongCat-Video [ 71 ] 和 MiniMax-H3 上实现 Trajectory LoRA，方法是在保持预训练权重固定的情况下，对选定的自注意力投影进行适配。 两个模型都采用锚点预热，随后在受引导的潜在状态上进行训练。 详细的训练与推理设置见补充材料。

sents.en: For training-free camera control, we use Wan2.1 I2V-14B [ 2 ] , with IRR applied during early denoising.
sents.zh: 对于免训练的相机控制，我们使用 Wan2.1 I2V-14B [ 2 ]，并在早期去噪阶段应用 IRR。

sents.en: We implement Trajectory LoRA on LongCat-Video [ 71 ] and MiniMax-H3 by adapting selected self-attention projections while keeping the pretrained weights fixed.
sents.zh: 我们在 LongCat-Video [ 71 ] 和 MiniMax-H3 上实现 Trajectory LoRA，方法是在保持预训练权重固定的情况下，对选定的自注意力投影进行适配。

sents.en: Both models use anchor warm-up followed by training on guided latent states.
sents.zh: 两个模型都采用锚点预热，随后在受引导的潜在状态上进行训练。

sents.en: Detailed training and inference settings are provided in the supplementary material.
sents.zh: 详细的训练与推理设置见补充材料。

paragraphs.en: The training-free evaluation covers static scenes and dynamic videos from diverse sources. The static 3D setting contains more than 70 source views from over 40 scenes, including LLFF [ 79 ] , Tanks and Temples [ 80 ] , Mip-NeRF 360 [ 81 ] , and real or generated images. The dynamic 4D setting contains more than 50 trajectory-controlled outputs from over 30 source videos, including DAVIS [ 82 ] , movie clips, and videos generated by video diffusion models.
paragraphs.zh: 无需训练的评估涵盖了静态场景以及来自多种来源的动态视频。 静态 3D 设定包含来自 40 多个场景的 70 多个源视图，包括 LLFF [ 79 ]、Tanks and Temples [ 80 ]、Mip-NeRF 360 [ 81 ] 以及真实或生成的图像。 动态 4D 设定包含来自 30 多个源视频的 50 多个轨迹控制的输出，包括 DAVIS [ 82 ]、电影片段以及由视频扩散模型生成的视频。

sents.en: The training-free evaluation covers static scenes and dynamic videos from diverse sources.
sents.zh: 无需训练的评估涵盖了静态场景以及来自多种来源的动态视频。

sents.en: The static 3D setting contains more than 70 source views from over 40 scenes, including LLFF [ 79 ] , Tanks and Temples [ 80 ] , Mip-NeRF 360 [ 81 ] , and real or generated images.
sents.zh: 静态 3D 设定包含来自 40 多个场景的 70 多个源视图，包括 LLFF [ 79 ]、Tanks and Temples [ 80 ]、Mip-NeRF 360 [ 81 ] 以及真实或生成的图像。

sents.en: The dynamic 4D setting contains more than 50 trajectory-controlled outputs from over 30 source videos, including DAVIS [ 82 ] , movie clips, and videos generated by video diffusion models.
sents.zh: 动态 4D 设定包含来自 30 多个源视频的 50 多个轨迹控制的输出，包括 DAVIS [ 82 ]、电影片段以及由视频扩散模型生成的视频。

paragraphs.en: For LoRA adaptation, we construct trajectory–video pairs from optimized 3D Gaussian Splatting representations [ 32 ] of DL3DV scenes [ 77 ] . Warping a source view along a target camera path provides the partial reference and its visibility mask; rendering the scene along the same path supplies the target video. The main comparison uses 200 test cases, with five random camera trajectories per scene across 40 scenes. Sequences contain 25–93 frames, with the length adapted to each method’s supported input format. Training and test scenes are disjoint.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 LoRA 适配，我们从 DL3DV 场景 [77] 的优化后 3D 高斯泼溅表示 [32] 构建轨迹–视频对。 沿目标相机路径对源视图进行扭曲可提供部分参考及其可见性掩码；沿同一路径渲染场景则提供目标视频。 主对比实验使用 200 个测试用例，涵盖 40 个场景，每个场景包含五条随机相机轨迹。 序列包含 25–93 帧，长度根据每种方法支持的输入格式进行调整。 训练场景与测试场景互不相交。

sents.en: For LoRA adaptation, we construct trajectory–video pairs from optimized 3D Gaussian Splatting representations [ 32 ] of DL3DV scenes [ 77 ] .
sents.zh: 对于 LoRA 适配，我们从 DL3DV 场景 [77] 的优化后 3D 高斯泼溅表示 [32] 构建轨迹–视频对。

sents.en: The main comparison uses 200 test cases, with five random camera trajectories per scene across 40 scenes.
sents.zh: 主对比实验使用 200 个测试用例，涵盖 40 个场景，每个场景包含五条随机相机轨迹。

sents.en: Sequences contain 25–93 frames, with the length adapted to each method’s supported input format.
sents.zh: 序列包含 25–93 帧，长度根据每种方法支持的输入格式进行调整。

sents.en: Training and test scenes are disjoint.
sents.zh: 训练场景与测试场景互不相交。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate visual quality and camera accuracy together. The training-free experiments use FID and CLIP similarity for static scenes, and FVD and CLIP-V similarity for dynamic videos. For Trajectory LoRA, we additionally evaluate target-view reconstruction with pixel-level metrics, PSNR and SSIM, and the perceptual metric LPIPS. Vis-LPIPS and Disocc-LPIPS assess preservation of visible content and completion of newly exposed regions, respectively. ATE measures overall trajectory agreement, while RPE-T and RPE-R measure local translation and rotation errors. Metric implementations are specified in the supplementary material.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将视觉质量与相机准确性一并评估。 免训练实验对静态场景使用 FID 和 CLIP 相似度，对动态视频使用 FVD 和 CLIP-V 相似度。 对于 Trajectory LoRA，我们额外使用像素级指标 PSNR 和 SSIM 以及感知指标 LPIPS 评估目标视角重建。 Vis-LPIPS 与 Disocc-LPIPS 分别评估可见内容的保留与新暴露区域的补全。 ATE 衡量整体轨迹一致性，而 RPE-T 和 RPE-R 衡量局部平移与旋转误差。 指标的具体实现见补充材料。

sents.zh: 我们将视觉质量与相机准确性一并评估。

sents.zh: ATE 衡量整体轨迹一致性，而 RPE-T 和 RPE-R 衡量局部平移与旋转误差。

sents.en: Metric implementations are specified in the supplementary material.
sents.zh: 指标的具体实现见补充材料。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate whether warped-reference guidance can follow a prescribed camera path while retaining the scene priors of a frozen video backbone. For static 3D generation, we compare with See3D [ 49 ] , ViewCrafter [ 4 ] , ViewExtrapolator [ 17 ] , TrajectoryAttention [ 15 ] , TrajectoryCrafter [ 5 ] , and NVS-Solver [ 6 ] . For dynamic 4D re-rendering, we compare with ViewExtrapolator, TrajectoryAttention, and TrajectoryCrafter using matched source videos and target trajectories. ReCamMaster [ 14 ] does not directly accept warped reference videos as trajectory inputs and is therefore included only in the qualitative comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估扭曲参考引导能否沿预设相机路径进行渲染，同时保留冻结视频骨干的场景先验。 对于静态3D生成，我们与 See3D [49]、ViewCrafter [4]、ViewExtrapolator [17]、TrajectoryAttention [15]、TrajectoryCrafter [5] 和 NVS-Solver [6] 进行比较。 对于动态4D重渲染，我们使用匹配的源视频和目标轨迹，与 ViewExtrapolator、TrajectoryAttention 和 TrajectoryCrafter 进行比较。 ReCamMaster [14] 不能直接接受扭曲参考视频作为轨迹输入，因此仅纳入定性比较。

sents.en: We evaluate whether warped-reference guidance can follow a prescribed camera path while retaining the scene priors of a frozen video backbone.
sents.zh: 我们评估扭曲参考引导能否沿预设相机路径进行渲染，同时保留冻结视频骨干的场景先验。

sents.en: For static 3D generation, we compare with See3D [ 49 ] , ViewCrafter [ 4 ] , ViewExtrapolator [ 17 ] , TrajectoryAttention [ 15 ] , TrajectoryCrafter [ 5 ] , and NVS-Solver [ 6 ] .
sents.zh: 对于静态3D生成，我们与 See3D [49]、ViewCrafter [4]、ViewExtrapolator [17]、TrajectoryAttention [15]、TrajectoryCrafter [5] 和 NVS-Solver [6] 进行比较。

sents.en: For dynamic 4D re-rendering, we compare with ViewExtrapolator, TrajectoryAttention, and TrajectoryCrafter using matched source videos and target trajectories.
sents.zh: 对于动态4D重渲染，我们使用匹配的源视频和目标轨迹，与 ViewExtrapolator、TrajectoryAttention 和 TrajectoryCrafter 进行比较。

sents.en: ReCamMaster [ 14 ] does not directly accept warped reference videos as trajectory inputs and is therefore included only in the qualitative comparison.
sents.zh: ReCamMaster [14] 不能直接接受扭曲参考视频作为轨迹输入，因此仅纳入定性比较。

paragraphs.en: Tables I and II show that Ours (Training-Free) combines accurate camera motion with strong generation quality. It achieves the best results on all static metrics and leads in FVD, CLIP-V similarity, RPE-T, and RPE-R on dynamic videos. Under large viewpoint changes, our method preserves human identity, object motion, and scene structure (Fig. 3 ). Competing methods more often produce flattened geometry, floating structures, or implausible content in newly revealed regions. The warped references provide explicit camera constraints, while the video model supplies the scene content needed for realistic 3D and 4D generation.
paragraphs.zh: 表I和表II表明，我们的（免训练）方法将精确的相机运动与强大的生成质量相结合。 它在所有静态指标上取得最佳结果，并在动态视频的FVD、CLIP-V相似度、RPE-T和RPE-R上领先。 在大幅视角变化下，我们的方法能保持人体身份、物体运动和场景结构（图3）。 竞争方法更常产生扁平化的几何、漂浮的结构，或在新显露区域中出现不合理的内容。 扭曲的参考图像提供了显式的相机约束，而视频模型提供了实现逼真3D和4D生成所需的场景内容。

sents.en: Tables I and II show that Ours (Training-Free) combines accurate camera motion with strong generation quality.
sents.zh: 表I和表II表明，我们的（免训练）方法将精确的相机运动与强大的生成质量相结合。

sents.en: It achieves the best results on all static metrics and leads in FVD, CLIP-V similarity, RPE-T, and RPE-R on dynamic videos.
sents.zh: 它在所有静态指标上取得最佳结果，并在动态视频的FVD、CLIP-V相似度、RPE-T和RPE-R上领先。

sents.en: Under large viewpoint changes, our method preserves human identity, object motion, and scene structure (Fig. 3 ).
sents.zh: 在大幅视角变化下，我们的方法能保持人体身份、物体运动和场景结构（图3）。

sents.en: Competing methods more often produce flattened geometry, floating structures, or implausible content in newly revealed regions.
sents.zh: 竞争方法更常产生扁平化的几何、漂浮的结构，或在新显露区域中出现不合理的内容。

sents.en: The warped references provide explicit camera constraints, while the video model supplies the scene content needed for realistic 3D and 4D generation.
sents.zh: 扭曲的参考图像提供了显式的相机约束，而视频模型提供了实现逼真3D和4D生成所需的场景内容。

paragraphs.en: The training-free results establish rendered references as an effective source of camera guidance. We next examine two questions: can the clean-estimate correction be approximated directly in noisy latent space to reduce sampling cost, and can limited trajectory supervision be concentrated in the network components most useful for camera control? V-Cache addresses the first question, while Trajectory LoRA uses this selective adaptation to learn control from very little data.
paragraphs.zh: 免训练的结果证明了渲染参考是相机引导的有效来源。 接下来我们考察两个问题：能否在噪声潜空间中直接近似干净估计校正以降低采样成本，以及能否将有限的轨迹监督集中在网络中对相机控制最有用的组件上？ V-Cache 回答了第一个问题，而 Trajectory LoRA 利用这种选择性适配，仅用极少数据就学会了控制。

sents.en: The training-free results establish rendered references as an effective source of camera guidance.
sents.zh: 免训练的结果证明了渲染参考是相机引导的有效来源。

sents.en: We next examine two questions: can the clean-estimate correction be approximated directly in noisy latent space to reduce sampling cost, and can limited trajectory supervision be concentrated in the network components most useful for camera control?
sents.zh: 接下来我们考察两个问题：能否在噪声潜空间中直接近似干净估计校正以降低采样成本，以及能否将有限的轨迹监督集中在网络中对相机控制最有用的组件上？

sents.en: V-Cache addresses the first question, while Trajectory LoRA uses this selective adaptation to learn control from very little data.
sents.zh: V-Cache 回答了第一个问题，而 Trajectory LoRA 利用这种选择性适配，仅用极少数据就学会了控制。

paragraphs.en: Direct reference insertion combines an externally noised observation with a latent following the model’s denoising path. To test their noise-state compatibility, we compare Direct Insertion, Only IRR, and V-Cache across denoising steps with the same inputs, target trajectories, and sampling settings (Fig. 4 ). For a latent x i x_{i} at noise level σ i \sigma_{i} , the model velocity v i v_{i} gives the inferred noise endpoint ϵ ^ i = x i + ( 1 − σ i ) ​ v i \hat{\epsilon}_{i}=x_{i}+(1-\sigma_{i})v_{i} . We compute its mean and variance in the warped-visible and model-generated regions and plot the mean and log-variance gaps. Direct Insertion leaves persistent gaps, accompanied by noisy patches, discontinuous boundaries, and local structural errors. IRR reduces these gaps by fusing the reference in clean-estimate space and re-noising the result with one noise sample. V-Cache achieves a similar reduction without additional model evaluations (NFE), making correction more efficient.
paragraphs.zh: 直接引用插入将外部加噪的观测与沿模型去噪路径得到的潜在表示相结合。 为测试它们的噪声状态兼容性，我们在相同的输入、目标轨迹和采样设置下，比较直接插入、仅 IRR 与 V-Cache 在各去噪步骤上的表现（图 4）。 对于噪声水平为 σ i \sigma_{i} 的潜在表示 x i x_{i} ，模型速度 v i v_{i} 给出推断的噪声终点 ϵ ^ i = x i + ( 1 − σ i ) ​ v i \hat{\epsilon}_{i}=x_{i}+(1-\sigma_{i})v_{i} 。 我们在扭曲可见区域和模型生成区域计算其均值与方差，并绘制均值差距与对数方差差距。 直接插入会留下持续的差距，并伴随噪声斑块、不连续边界以及局部结构错误。 IRR 通过在干净估计空间中融合参考并使用一个噪声样本对结果重新加噪，从而缩小这些差距。 V-Cache 在不增加额外模型评估次数（NFE）的情况下实现了类似的差距缩小，使修正更加高效。

sents.en: Direct reference insertion combines an externally noised observation with a latent following the model’s denoising path.
sents.zh: 直接引用插入将外部加噪的观测与沿模型去噪路径得到的潜在表示相结合。

sents.en: To test their noise-state compatibility, we compare Direct Insertion, Only IRR, and V-Cache across denoising steps with the same inputs, target trajectories, and sampling settings (Fig. 4 ).
sents.zh: 为测试它们的噪声状态兼容性，我们在相同的输入、目标轨迹和采样设置下，比较直接插入、仅 IRR 与 V-Cache 在各去噪步骤上的表现（图 4）。

sents.en: For a latent x i x_{i} at noise level σ i \sigma_{i} , the model velocity v i v_{i} gives the inferred noise endpoint ϵ ^ i = x i + ( 1 − σ i ) ​ v i \hat{\epsilon}_{i}=x_{i}+(1-\sigma_{i})v_{i} .
sents.zh: 对于噪声水平为 σ i \sigma_{i} 的潜在表示 x i x_{i} ，模型速度 v i v_{i} 给出推断的噪声终点 ϵ ^ i = x i + ( 1 − σ i ) ​ v i \hat{\epsilon}_{i}=x_{i}+(1-\sigma_{i})v_{i} 。

sents.en: We compute its mean and variance in the warped-visible and model-generated regions and plot the mean and log-variance gaps.
sents.zh: 我们在扭曲可见区域和模型生成区域计算其均值与方差，并绘制均值差距与对数方差差距。

sents.en: Direct Insertion leaves persistent gaps, accompanied by noisy patches, discontinuous boundaries, and local structural errors.
sents.zh: 直接插入会留下持续的差距，并伴随噪声斑块、不连续边界以及局部结构错误。

sents.en: IRR reduces these gaps by fusing the reference in clean-estimate space and re-noising the result with one noise sample.
sents.zh: IRR 通过在干净估计空间中融合参考并使用一个噪声样本对结果重新加噪，从而缩小这些差距。

sents.en: V-Cache achieves a similar reduction without additional model evaluations (NFE), making correction more efficient.
sents.zh: V-Cache 在不增加额外模型评估次数（NFE）的情况下实现了类似的差距缩小，使修正更加高效。

paragraphs.en: Trajectory LoRA adapts only selected trajectory-sensitive blocks to strengthen the model’s response to camera guidance. We use V-Cache to inject the target trajectory and compare the adapted models with UniWorld-View [ 83 ] , TrajectoryCrafter [ 5 ] , SymphoMotion [ 84 ] , and Warp-as-History [ 18 ] on trajectory accuracy, preservation of observed content, and completion of newly revealed regions. Both models use rank-128 LoRA and 50 trajectory–video training pairs. LongCat adapts its 36 most trajectory-sensitive blocks (75%) for 1,200 updates using eight scenes; H3 adapts its 38 most sensitive blocks (approximately 75%) for 1,500 updates using one scene. These main-comparison settings are the defaults for ablations, which vary the factor under study.
paragraphs.zh: 轨迹 LoRA 仅对选定的轨迹敏感模块进行适配，以增强模型对相机引导的响应。 我们使用 V-Cache 注入目标轨迹，并将适配后的模型与 UniWorld-View [83]、TrajectoryCrafter [5]、SymphoMotion [84] 和 Warp-as-History [18] 在轨迹准确性、已观测内容的保留以及新揭示区域的补全方面进行比较。 两个模型均使用秩为 128 的 LoRA 以及 50 对轨迹–视频训练数据。 LongCat 使用八个场景对其 36 个最轨迹敏感的模块（75%）进行 1,200 次更新的适配；H3 使用一个场景对其 38 个最敏感的模块（约 75%）进行 1,500 次更新的适配。 这些主要比较设置是消融实验的默认设置，消融实验会改变所研究的因素。

sents.en: Trajectory LoRA adapts only selected trajectory-sensitive blocks to strengthen the model’s response to camera guidance.
sents.zh: 轨迹 LoRA 仅对选定的轨迹敏感模块进行适配，以增强模型对相机引导的响应。

sents.en: We use V-Cache to inject the target trajectory and compare the adapted models with UniWorld-View [ 83 ] , TrajectoryCrafter [ 5 ] , SymphoMotion [ 84 ] , and Warp-as-History [ 18 ] on trajectory accuracy, preservation of observed content, and completion of newly revealed regions.
sents.zh: 我们使用 V-Cache 注入目标轨迹，并将适配后的模型与 UniWorld-View [83]、TrajectoryCrafter [5]、SymphoMotion [84] 和 Warp-as-History [18] 在轨迹准确性、已观测内容的保留以及新揭示区域的补全方面进行比较。

sents.en: Both models use rank-128 LoRA and 50 trajectory–video training pairs.
sents.zh: 两个模型均使用秩为 128 的 LoRA 以及 50 对轨迹–视频训练数据。

sents.en: LongCat adapts its 36 most trajectory-sensitive blocks (75%) for 1,200 updates using eight scenes; H3 adapts its 38 most sensitive blocks (approximately 75%) for 1,500 updates using one scene.
sents.zh: LongCat 使用八个场景对其 36 个最轨迹敏感的模块（75%）进行 1,200 次更新的适配；H3 使用一个场景对其 38 个最敏感的模块（约 75%）进行 1,500 次更新的适配。

sents.en: These main-comparison settings are the defaults for ablations, which vary the factor under study.
sents.zh: 这些主要比较设置是消融实验的默认设置，消融实验会改变所研究的因素。

paragraphs.en: Both adapted models outperform the baselines on all five reconstruction metrics (Table III ). The gains in Vis-LPIPS and Disocc-LPIPS show improved preservation of observed content and completion of newly exposed regions. H3 also achieves the lowest local camera errors, combining faithful scene reconstruction with accurate camera motion. Figure 5 illustrates these improvements in thin structures and partially revealed objects: our models retain material detail and coherent shapes where the warped reference is incomplete, producing fewer rendering artifacts and more continuous geometry along the requested path.
paragraphs.zh: 两个适配后的模型在全部五个重建指标上均优于基线（表III）。 Vis-LPIPS 和 Disocc-LPIPS 的提升表明对已观测内容的保留以及对新暴露区域的补全都得到了改善。 H3 还取得了最低的局部相机误差，将忠实的场景重建与准确的相机运动相结合。 图5展示了在细结构和部分显现物体上的这些改进：在 warped 参考不完整的地方，我们的模型保留了材质细节和连贯的形状，沿请求路径产生了更少的渲染伪影和更连续的几何。

sents.en: Both adapted models outperform the baselines on all five reconstruction metrics (Table III ).
sents.zh: 两个适配后的模型在全部五个重建指标上均优于基线（表III）。

sents.en: The gains in Vis-LPIPS and Disocc-LPIPS show improved preservation of observed content and completion of newly exposed regions.
sents.zh: Vis-LPIPS 和 Disocc-LPIPS 的提升表明对已观测内容的保留以及对新暴露区域的补全都得到了改善。

sents.en: H3 also achieves the lowest local camera errors, combining faithful scene reconstruction with accurate camera motion.
sents.zh: H3 还取得了最低的局部相机误差，将忠实的场景重建与准确的相机运动相结合。

sents.en: Figure 5 illustrates these improvements in thin structures and partially revealed objects: our models retain material detail and coherent shapes where the warped reference is incomplete, producing fewer rendering artifacts and more continuous geometry along the requested path.
sents.zh: 图5展示了在细结构和部分显现物体上的这些改进：在 warped 参考不完整的地方，我们的模型保留了材质细节和连贯的形状，沿请求路径产生了更少的渲染伪影和更连续的几何。

paragraphs.en: The inference-time guidance transfers directly to the U-Net-based SVD [ 1 ] and the Transformer-based LongCat-Video, and remains effective with different depth and optical-flow estimators (see the supplementary material). Trajectory LoRA offers a complementary form of transfer. The same LongCat adapter can be attached to Warp-as-History [ 18 ] and Go-with-the-Flow [ 16 ] without further fine-tuning. It improves the model’s response to the injected trajectory under both methods, reducing structural degradation and preserving more surface and object detail (Fig. 6 ). These results show that the selected blocks learn broader trajectory-control capabilities that transfer across injection interfaces.
paragraphs.zh: 推理时引导可直接迁移到基于 U-Net 的 SVD [1] 和基于 Transformer 的 LongCat-Video，并且在不同的深度和光流估计器下依然有效（见补充材料）。 轨迹 LoRA 提供了另一种互补的迁移形式。 同一个 LongCat 适配器可以直接挂载到 Warp-as-History [18] 和 Go-with-the-Flow [16] 上，无需进一步微调。 它提升了模型在这两种方法下对注入轨迹的响应，减少了结构退化，并保留了更多的表面和物体细节（图 6）。 这些结果表明，所选模块学习到了更广泛的轨迹控制能力，并能跨注入接口迁移。

sents.zh: 推理时引导可直接迁移到基于 U-Net 的 SVD [1] 和基于 Transformer 的 LongCat-Video，并且在不同的深度和光流估计器下依然有效（见补充材料）。

sents.en: Trajectory LoRA offers a complementary form of transfer.
sents.zh: 轨迹 LoRA 提供了另一种互补的迁移形式。

sents.zh: 同一个 LongCat 适配器可以直接挂载到 Warp-as-History [18] 和 Go-with-the-Flow [16] 上，无需进一步微调。

sents.en: It improves the model’s response to the injected trajectory under both methods, reducing structural degradation and preserving more surface and object detail (Fig. 6 ).
sents.zh: 它提升了模型在这两种方法下对注入轨迹的响应，减少了结构退化，并保留了更多的表面和物体细节（图 6）。

sents.en: These results show that the selected blocks learn broader trajectory-control capabilities that transfer across injection interfaces.
sents.zh: 这些结果表明，所选模块学习到了更广泛的轨迹控制能力，并能跨注入接口迁移。

paragraphs.en: Training resources and inference efficiency, including accelerated generation with Trajectory LoRA, are reported in Sec. 4.4 of the supplementary material (Table S4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 训练资源与推理效率，包括使用轨迹 LoRA（Trajectory LoRA）进行加速生成，报告于补充材料的第 4.4 节（表 S4）。

paragraphs.en: Our ablations test how each design contributes to camera control. Following the noise-state analysis of IRR and V-Cache, we examine how FLF and DSG preserve generation quality during trajectory guidance. We then assess the effectiveness of the selected trajectory-sensitive blocks, how efficiently these blocks learn from limited scenes, and how the two training stages prepare the adapter for V-Cache-guided denoising.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的消融实验测试了每个设计对相机控制的贡献。 沿用 IRR 与 V-Cache 的噪声状态分析，我们考察 FLF 与 DSG 如何在轨迹引导过程中保持生成质量。 随后，我们评估所选轨迹敏感模块的有效性、这些模块从有限场景中学习的效率，以及两个训练阶段如何让适配器为 V-Cache 引导的去噪做好准备。

sents.en: Our ablations test how each design contributes to camera control.
sents.zh: 我们的消融实验测试了每个设计对相机控制的贡献。

sents.en: Following the noise-state analysis of IRR and V-Cache, we examine how FLF and DSG preserve generation quality during trajectory guidance.
sents.zh: 沿用 IRR 与 V-Cache 的噪声状态分析，我们考察 FLF 与 DSG 如何在轨迹引导过程中保持生成质量。

sents.en: We then assess the effectiveness of the selected trajectory-sensitive blocks, how efficiently these blocks learn from limited scenes, and how the two training stages prepare the adapter for V-Cache-guided denoising.
sents.zh: 随后，我们评估所选轨迹敏感模块的有效性、这些模块从有限场景中学习的效率，以及两个训练阶段如何让适配器为 V-Cache 引导的去噪做好准备。

paragraphs.en: IRR injects the target trajectory through the warped reference; removing this injection leaves the model without camera guidance. FLF confines reference fusion to channels aligned with the target motion, allowing the others to retain the model’s appearance prediction. Removing this selection applies fusion to all channels and disrupts appearance. DSG corrects warped-reference distortions using the model’s original prediction. The guided and unguided velocities differ substantially in direction, making standard CFG unstable. Table IV shows that removing FLF or DSG reduces static and dynamic generation quality, while replacing DSG with its CFG form causes further degradation. The complete framework performs best on all four quality metrics, combining appearance-preserving fusion with correction of guidance artifacts. Qualitative component comparisons are provided in the supplementary material.
paragraphs.zh: IRR 通过经变形的参考注入目标轨迹；移除此注入后，模型将失去相机引导。 FLF 将参考融合限制在与目标运动对齐的通道上，使其他通道保留模型的外观预测。 移除此选择会将融合应用于所有通道，并破坏外观。 DSG 利用模型的原始预测来纠正经变形参考中的失真。 有引导与无引导的速度在方向上差异显著，导致标准 CFG 不稳定。 表 IV 表明，移除 FLF 或 DSG 会降低静态与动态生成质量，而用其 CFG 形式替换 DSG 会导致进一步的性能下降。 完整框架在全部四项质量指标上表现最佳，将保留外观的融合与对引导伪影的纠正相结合。 定性的组件对比见补充材料。

sents.en: IRR injects the target trajectory through the warped reference; removing this injection leaves the model without camera guidance.
sents.zh: IRR 通过经变形的参考注入目标轨迹；移除此注入后，模型将失去相机引导。

sents.en: FLF confines reference fusion to channels aligned with the target motion, allowing the others to retain the model’s appearance prediction.
sents.zh: FLF 将参考融合限制在与目标运动对齐的通道上，使其他通道保留模型的外观预测。

sents.en: Removing this selection applies fusion to all channels and disrupts appearance.
sents.zh: 移除此选择会将融合应用于所有通道，并破坏外观。

sents.en: DSG corrects warped-reference distortions using the model’s original prediction.
sents.zh: DSG 利用模型的原始预测来纠正经变形参考中的失真。

sents.en: The guided and unguided velocities differ substantially in direction, making standard CFG unstable.
sents.zh: 有引导与无引导的速度在方向上差异显著，导致标准 CFG 不稳定。

sents.en: Table IV shows that removing FLF or DSG reduces static and dynamic generation quality, while replacing DSG with its CFG form causes further degradation.
sents.zh: 表 IV 表明，移除 FLF 或 DSG 会降低静态与动态生成质量，而用其 CFG 形式替换 DSG 会导致进一步的性能下降。

sents.en: The complete framework performs best on all four quality metrics, combining appearance-preserving fusion with correction of guidance artifacts.
sents.zh: 完整框架在全部四项质量指标上表现最佳，将保留外观的融合与对引导伪影的纠正相结合。

sents.en: Qualitative component comparisons are provided in the supplementary material.
sents.zh: 定性的组件对比见补充材料。

paragraphs.en: We use Shapley analysis [ 78 ] to measure how strongly each self-attention block responds to trajectory supervision. A block’s score averages its marginal contribution to the full probe LoRA’s velocity response across different combinations of active adapters. After brief probe LoRA training on each backbone, Fig. 7 reveals clear differences in sensitivity. LongCat’s responsive blocks are dispersed through the middle and later layers, while H3 shows a more regular concentration in later layers.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Shapley 分析 [ 78 ] 来衡量每个自注意力模块对轨迹监督的响应强度。 一个模块的得分是其在不同激活适配器组合下对完整探测 LoRA 的速度响应的平均边际贡献。 在每个主干上进行简短的探测 LoRA 训练后，图 7 显示出明显的敏感性差异。 LongCat 的响应模块分散在中部和较后的层中，而 H3 在较后的层中表现出更为集中的规律性分布。

sents.en: We use Shapley analysis [ 78 ] to measure how strongly each self-attention block responds to trajectory supervision.
sents.zh: 我们使用 Shapley 分析 [ 78 ] 来衡量每个自注意力模块对轨迹监督的响应强度。

sents.en: A block’s score averages its marginal contribution to the full probe LoRA’s velocity response across different combinations of active adapters.
sents.zh: 一个模块的得分是其在不同激活适配器组合下对完整探测 LoRA 的速度响应的平均边际贡献。

sents.en: After brief probe LoRA training on each backbone, Fig. 7 reveals clear differences in sensitivity.
sents.zh: 在每个主干上进行简短的探测 LoRA 训练后，图 7 显示出明显的敏感性差异。

sents.en: LongCat’s responsive blocks are dispersed through the middle and later layers, while H3 shows a more regular concentration in later layers.
sents.zh: LongCat 的响应模块分散在中部和较后的层中，而 H3 在较后的层中表现出更为集中的规律性分布。

paragraphs.en: To test whether this sensitivity guides effective adaptation, we train different proportions of the highest-scoring blocks and compare them with full-block adaptation. Controls use the least responsive half or a random half, with random-selection results averaged over five independent training runs. All LoRA ablations use the same 100 test cases: five random camera trajectories from each of 20 randomly selected DL3DV scenes, disjoint from all training scenes. Other training settings follow the default configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 为检验这种敏感性是否能引导有效适配，我们训练得分最高的块的不同比例，并与全块适配进行比较。 对照组使用响应最低的一半或随机选取的一半，其中随机选取的结果在五次独立训练运行上取平均。 所有 LoRA 消融实验使用相同的 100 个测试用例：从 20 个随机选取的 DL3DV 场景中各取五条随机相机轨迹，且这些场景与所有训练场景互不相交。 其他训练设置遵循默认配置。

sents.en: To test whether this sensitivity guides effective adaptation, we train different proportions of the highest-scoring blocks and compare them with full-block adaptation.
sents.zh: 为检验这种敏感性是否能引导有效适配，我们训练得分最高的块的不同比例，并与全块适配进行比较。

sents.en: Controls use the least responsive half or a random half, with random-selection results averaged over five independent training runs.
sents.zh: 对照组使用响应最低的一半或随机选取的一半，其中随机选取的结果在五次独立训练运行上取平均。

sents.en: All LoRA ablations use the same 100 test cases: five random camera trajectories from each of 20 randomly selected DL3DV scenes, disjoint from all training scenes.
sents.zh: 所有 LoRA 消融实验使用相同的 100 个测试用例：从 20 个随机选取的 DL3DV 场景中各取五条随机相机轨迹，且这些场景与所有训练场景互不相交。

sents.en: Other training settings follow the default configuration.
sents.zh: 其他训练设置遵循默认配置。

paragraphs.en: Adapting roughly the most sensitive three quarters of the blocks matches or improves full-block performance (Table V ). LongCat’s 36 selected blocks improve reconstruction and local camera accuracy, while H3’s 38 selected blocks retain comparable reconstruction and reduce camera errors. These gains support leaving low-sensitivity blocks unadapted to preserve pretrained texture and appearance priors. The selected H3 blocks also reach good performance sooner than full-block adaptation (Fig. 8 ). At the same block count, selecting the sensitive half improves reconstruction over random selection on both backbones, while low-response selection performs worst. These comparisons validate our block-selection strategy.
paragraphs.zh: 对敏感度最高的大约四分之三的模块进行适配，其效果与全模块适配相当甚至更好（表 V）。 LongCat 选出的 36 个模块提升了重建和局部相机精度，而 H3 选出的 38 个模块在保持相当重建精度的同时降低了相机误差。 这些增益支持让低敏感度模块保持不适配，以保留预训练的纹理和外观先验。 所选的 H3 模块也比全模块适配更快地达到良好性能（图 8）。 在相同模块数量下，在两个骨干网络上选择敏感度较高的一半模块都比随机选择获得更好的重建效果，而低响应选择的表现最差。 这些对比验证了我们的模块选择策略。

sents.en: Adapting roughly the most sensitive three quarters of the blocks matches or improves full-block performance (Table V ).
sents.zh: 对敏感度最高的大约四分之三的模块进行适配，其效果与全模块适配相当甚至更好（表 V）。

sents.zh: LongCat 选出的 36 个模块提升了重建和局部相机精度，而 H3 选出的 38 个模块在保持相当重建精度的同时降低了相机误差。

sents.zh: 这些增益支持让低敏感度模块保持不适配，以保留预训练的纹理和外观先验。

sents.en: The selected H3 blocks also reach good performance sooner than full-block adaptation (Fig. 8 ).
sents.zh: 所选的 H3 模块也比全模块适配更快地达到良好性能（图 8）。

sents.en: At the same block count, selecting the sensitive half improves reconstruction over random selection on both backbones, while low-response selection performs worst.
sents.zh: 在相同模块数量下，在两个骨干网络上选择敏感度较高的一半模块都比随机选择获得更好的重建效果，而低响应选择的表现最差。

sents.en: These comparisons validate our block-selection strategy.
sents.zh: 这些对比验证了我们的模块选择策略。

paragraphs.en: With adaptation focused on trajectory-sensitive blocks, we examine how much scene diversity is needed for reliable camera control. We draw a fixed total of 50 trajectory–video pairs from one, two, four, or eight DL3DV scenes, keeping other training settings unchanged. Both backbones already achieve good reconstruction and control with one scene (Table VI ). Added diversity improves LongCat’s reconstruction and rotation accuracy, while H3 gains mainly in translation accuracy. Most gains are reached with two to four scenes; extending coverage to eight brings limited further benefit. These results show that the training strategy uses scene supervision efficiently, enabling reliable trajectory control and high-quality generation on unseen scenes from few examples.
paragraphs.zh: 在仅针对轨迹敏感模块进行适配的情况下，我们考察需要多少场景多样性才能实现可靠的相机控制。 我们从一个、两个、四个或八个 DL3DV 场景中固定抽取共 50 对轨迹—视频对，其余训练设置保持不变。 两种骨干网络仅用一个场景即可取得良好的重建与控制效果（表 VI）。 场景多样性的增加提升了 LongCat 的重建与旋转精度，而 H3 则主要在平移精度上有所提升。 大部分增益在两到四个场景时即可达到；将覆盖范围扩展到八个场景带来的额外收益有限。 这些结果表明，该训练策略能高效利用场景监督，仅需少量样本即可在未见场景上实现可靠的轨迹控制与高质量生成。

sents.en: With adaptation focused on trajectory-sensitive blocks, we examine how much scene diversity is needed for reliable camera control.
sents.zh: 在仅针对轨迹敏感模块进行适配的情况下，我们考察需要多少场景多样性才能实现可靠的相机控制。

sents.en: We draw a fixed total of 50 trajectory–video pairs from one, two, four, or eight DL3DV scenes, keeping other training settings unchanged.
sents.zh: 我们从一个、两个、四个或八个 DL3DV 场景中固定抽取共 50 对轨迹—视频对，其余训练设置保持不变。

sents.en: Both backbones already achieve good reconstruction and control with one scene (Table VI ).
sents.zh: 两种骨干网络仅用一个场景即可取得良好的重建与控制效果（表 VI）。

sents.en: Added diversity improves LongCat’s reconstruction and rotation accuracy, while H3 gains mainly in translation accuracy.
sents.zh: 场景多样性的增加提升了 LongCat 的重建与旋转精度，而 H3 则主要在平移精度上有所提升。

sents.en: Most gains are reached with two to four scenes; extending coverage to eight brings limited further benefit.
sents.zh: 大部分增益在两到四个场景时即可达到；将覆盖范围扩展到八个场景带来的额外收益有限。

sents.en: These results show that the training strategy uses scene supervision efficiently, enabling reliable trajectory control and high-quality generation on unseen scenes from few examples.
sents.zh: 这些结果表明，该训练策略能高效利用场景监督，仅需少量样本即可在未见场景上实现可靠的轨迹控制与高质量生成。

paragraphs.en: We next vary training updates while fixing each backbone’s training data and other settings. Figure 8 tracks the eight-scene LongCat and single-scene H3 configurations, with additional scene-count comparisons and full-block adaptation on H3. LongCat trains more stably with eight scenes and reaches its best perceptual quality near 1,200 updates; longer training brings little benefit and eventually shows signs of overfitting. H3 learns reliably from one scene. Removing LoRA from its less sensitive blocks accelerates convergence and improves perceptual quality over full-block adaptation. Later updates refine camera accuracy as perceptual quality stabilizes, with diminishing gains. Thus, the sensitive blocks learn to use trajectory guidance within relatively few updates.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们在固定每个骨干网络的训练数据和其他设置的前提下，改变训练更新次数。 图 8 展示了八场景的 LongCat 和单场景的 H3 配置，并包含额外的场景数量对比以及在 H3 上的全块适配结果。 LongCat 在八场景下训练更稳定，并在约 1,200 次更新时达到其最佳感知质量；更长的训练几乎不带来收益，且最终出现过拟合的迹象。 H3 能够可靠地从单个场景中学习。 从其不太敏感的块中移除 LoRA 能够加速收敛，并比全块适配提升感知质量。 在感知质量趋于稳定后，后续更新继续提升相机精度，但收益逐渐递减。 因此，敏感的块在相对较少的更新次数内就学会了利用轨迹引导。

sents.en: We next vary training updates while fixing each backbone’s training data and other settings.
sents.zh: 接下来，我们在固定每个骨干网络的训练数据和其他设置的前提下，改变训练更新次数。

sents.en: H3 learns reliably from one scene.
sents.zh: H3 能够可靠地从单个场景中学习。

sents.en: Removing LoRA from its less sensitive blocks accelerates convergence and improves perceptual quality over full-block adaptation.
sents.zh: 从其不太敏感的块中移除 LoRA 能够加速收敛，并比全块适配提升感知质量。

sents.en: Later updates refine camera accuracy as perceptual quality stabilizes, with diminishing gains.
sents.zh: 在感知质量趋于稳定后，后续更新继续提升相机精度，但收益逐渐递减。

sents.en: Thus, the sensitive blocks learn to use trajectory guidance within relatively few updates.
sents.zh: 因此，敏感的块在相对较少的更新次数内就学会了利用轨迹引导。

paragraphs.en: We compare Standard FM, Only warm-up, and w/o warm-up to isolate the effects of the training strategies, using 1,200 updates for LongCat and 1,500 for H3. The adapter must learn to denoise states modified by reference insertion and cached correction. Anchor warm-up first adapts it to intermediate states recorded during guided sampling; the second stage uses the warmed-up model and these states to construct guided inputs at additional noise levels. Table VII and Fig. 9 compare these variants with Full and w/o LoRA under fixed inference settings for each backbone. Standard FM uses independently noised targets. Only warm-up trains on recorded states without extending the noise range, while w/o warm-up skips initial adaptation but still constructs guided inputs from intermediate states at additional noise levels. The full strategy gives the best overall results across quantitative and qualitative comparisons, improving reconstruction over Standard FM on both backbones and achieving the best camera accuracy on H3. Removing LoRA gives the poorest reconstruction. Although Standard FM has low errors on some camera metrics, its training inputs differ substantially from inference-time guided states. This gap prevents reliable use of trajectory guidance, leaving holes, cracks, and rendering artifacts. Training on states that reproduce guided denoising restores continuous surfaces and finer detail.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对比了 Standard FM、Only warm-up 和 w/o warm-up，以分离各训练策略的效果，LongCat 使用 1,200 次更新，H3 使用 1,500 次更新。 适配器必须学会对因参考插入与缓存校正而被修改的状态进行去噪。 锚点预热首先使模型适应引导采样过程中记录的中间状态；第二阶段使用预热后的模型和这些状态，在额外噪声水平上构造引导输入。 表 VII 和图 9 在每个骨干网络固定的推理设置下，将这些变体与 Full 和 w/o LoRA 进行比较。 Standard FM 使用独立加噪的目标。 Only warm-up 仅在记录的状态上训练而不扩展噪声范围，而 w/o warm-up 跳过初始适应阶段，但仍在额外噪声水平上从中间状态构造引导输入。 完整策略在定量和定性比较中都给出了最佳的整体结果，在两个骨干网络上都提升了相对 Standard FM 的重建质量，并在 H3 上取得了最佳的相机精度。 移除 LoRA 后重建效果最差。 尽管 Standard FM 在部分相机指标上误差较低，但其训练输入与推理时的引导状态存在显著差异。 这一差距使轨迹引导无法可靠使用，导致出现孔洞、裂缝和渲染伪影。 在能够复现引导去噪的状态上训练可以恢复连续的表面和更精细的细节。

sents.zh: 适配器必须学会对因参考插入与缓存校正而被修改的状态进行去噪。

sents.en: Anchor warm-up first adapts it to intermediate states recorded during guided sampling; the second stage uses the warmed-up model and these states to construct guided inputs at additional noise levels.
sents.zh: 锚点预热首先使模型适应引导采样过程中记录的中间状态；第二阶段使用预热后的模型和这些状态，在额外噪声水平上构造引导输入。

sents.en: Table VII and Fig. 9 compare these variants with Full and w/o LoRA under fixed inference settings for each backbone.
sents.zh: 表 VII 和图 9 在每个骨干网络固定的推理设置下，将这些变体与 Full 和 w/o LoRA 进行比较。

sents.en: Standard FM uses independently noised targets.
sents.zh: Standard FM 使用独立加噪的目标。

sents.en: Only warm-up trains on recorded states without extending the noise range, while w/o warm-up skips initial adaptation but still constructs guided inputs from intermediate states at additional noise levels.
sents.zh: Only warm-up 仅在记录的状态上训练而不扩展噪声范围，而 w/o warm-up 跳过初始适应阶段，但仍在额外噪声水平上从中间状态构造引导输入。

sents.en: The full strategy gives the best overall results across quantitative and qualitative comparisons, improving reconstruction over Standard FM on both backbones and achieving the best camera accuracy on H3.
sents.zh: 完整策略在定量和定性比较中都给出了最佳的整体结果，在两个骨干网络上都提升了相对 Standard FM 的重建质量，并在 H3 上取得了最佳的相机精度。

sents.en: Removing LoRA gives the poorest reconstruction.
sents.zh: 移除 LoRA 后重建效果最差。

sents.en: Although Standard FM has low errors on some camera metrics, its training inputs differ substantially from inference-time guided states.
sents.zh: 尽管 Standard FM 在部分相机指标上误差较低，但其训练输入与推理时的引导状态存在显著差异。

sents.en: This gap prevents reliable use of trajectory guidance, leaving holes, cracks, and rendering artifacts.
sents.zh: 这一差距使轨迹引导无法可靠使用，导致出现孔洞、裂缝和渲染伪影。

sents.en: Training on states that reproduce guided denoising restores continuous surfaces and finer detail.
sents.zh: 在能够复现引导去噪的状态上训练可以恢复连续的表面和更精细的细节。

paragraphs.en: We presented WorldForge V2 for accurate camera control while preserving the generative capabilities of pretrained video models. Our training-free guidance uses warped references to iteratively refine generation along the requested camera path, with motion-aware channel selection and self-correction preserving scene appearance and object motion. Building on this guidance, v-cache reuses denoising predictions to approximate the refinement correction, reducing sampling cost. Trajectory LoRA extends motion localization from latent channels to network blocks and combines selective adaptation with two-stage training, enabling pretrained video models to learn reliable trajectory control from very few trajectory–video pairs. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations across multiple datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art generation quality and trajectory accuracy in camera-controlled video generation. Future work will explore long-horizon, real-time streaming generation with camera control to support the development of interactive world models.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 WorldForge V2，在保持预训练视频模型生成能力的同时实现精确的相机控制。 我们的免训练引导方法利用变形后的参考在指定的相机路径上迭代细化生成过程，并通过运动感知的通道选择与自我校正来保持场景外观和物体运动。 在该引导方法的基础上，v-cache 复用去噪预测来近似细化校正，从而降低采样成本。 轨迹 LoRA 将运动定位从隐通道扩展到网络模块，并结合选择性适配与两阶段训练，使预训练视频模型能够从极少的轨迹–视频对中学习可靠的轨迹控制。 在多个数据集上的定量和定性评估表明，本方法在相机控制视频生成中实现了最先进的生成质量和轨迹精度。 未来的工作将探索支持相机控制的长时程实时流式生成，以助力交互式世界模型的发展。

paragraphs.en: Camera control requires the generated video to follow the target path while preserving the scene. We evaluate these two aspects through visual quality and trajectory accuracy on the training-free benchmarks, and use the rendered DL3DV targets to further examine reconstruction of observed content and completion of newly exposed regions.
paragraphs.zh: 相机控制要求生成的视频在遵循目标路径的同时保留场景。 我们在免训练基准上通过视觉质量和轨迹准确度评估这两个方面，并使用渲染的 DL3DV 目标进一步检验对已观测内容的重建以及对新暴露区域的补全。

sents.en: Camera control requires the generated video to follow the target path while preserving the scene.
sents.zh: 相机控制要求生成的视频在遵循目标路径的同时保留场景。

sents.en: We evaluate these two aspects through visual quality and trajectory accuracy on the training-free benchmarks, and use the rendered DL3DV targets to further examine reconstruction of observed content and completion of newly exposed regions.
sents.zh: 我们在免训练基准上通过视觉质量和轨迹准确度评估这两个方面，并使用渲染的 DL3DV 目标进一步检验对已观测内容的重建以及对新暴露区域的补全。

paragraphs.en: The training-free static benchmark contains more than 70 source views from over 40 scenes, including LLFF, Tanks and Temples, Mip-NeRF 360, and real or generated images. The dynamic benchmark contains more than 50 trajectory-controlled outputs from over 30 source videos, including DAVIS, cinematic sequences, and videos generated by video diffusion models.
paragraphs.zh: 免训练静态基准包含来自 40 多个场景的 70 多个源视图，包括 LLFF、Tanks and Temples、Mip-NeRF 360 以及真实或生成的图像。 动态基准包含来自 30 多个源视频的 50 多个轨迹受控输出，包括 DAVIS、电影级序列以及由视频扩散模型生成的视频。

sents.en: The training-free static benchmark contains more than 70 source views from over 40 scenes, including LLFF, Tanks and Temples, Mip-NeRF 360, and real or generated images.

sents.en: The dynamic benchmark contains more than 50 trajectory-controlled outputs from over 30 source videos, including DAVIS, cinematic sequences, and videos generated by video diffusion models.

paragraphs.en: The learned-control experiments use DL3DV [ 77 ] , with disjoint training and test scenes. The main comparison contains 200 cases, with five random camera paths for each of 40 scenes. All LoRA ablations use the same 100 cases, comprising five random paths from each of 20 randomly selected scenes. Sequences contain 25–93 frames, with lengths adapted to each method’s supported input format. Across the benchmarks, methods within each comparison share the inputs, target trajectories, and evaluation cases.
paragraphs.zh: 学习控制实验使用 DL3DV [77]，其中训练场景与测试场景互不相交。 主对比包含 200 个案例，即 40 个场景中每个场景各五条随机相机路径。 所有 LoRA 消融实验使用相同的 100 个案例，即从随机选取的 20 个场景中每个场景各五条随机路径。 序列包含 25–93 帧，长度根据每种方法所支持的输入格式进行调整。 在各基准测试中，每次对比内的各方法共享相同的输入、目标轨迹和评估案例。

paragraphs.en: Flow-Gated Latent Fusion (FLF) uses motion agreement to select the latent channels that receive trajectory guidance. At each denoising step i i , we compare the motion in each predicted channel with that in the rendered reference and assign a score S i c S_{i}^{c} . Channels with high scores receive the reference fusion, while the others retain the model’s prediction to preserve appearance details.
paragraphs.zh: 流门控潜变量融合（FLF）利用运动一致性来选择接收轨迹引导的潜变量通道。 在每个去噪步骤 i i 中，我们将每个预测通道中的运动与渲染参考中的运动进行比较，并赋予分数 S i c S_{i}^{c}。 得分高的通道接收参考融合，而其余通道则保留模型的预测以保持外观细节。

paragraphs.en: Early latent states are too noisy for reliable flow estimation, so we disable channel filtering and inject the reference into all channels during steps 0–5. As the motion estimates become more reliable, we allow at most two of Wan2.1’s 16 channels to retain the original prediction during steps 6–10; at least 14 channels therefore continue to receive the reference. During steps 11–19, we relax this limit to six channels, giving the model more freedom to recover texture while maintaining trajectory guidance in the remaining channels. These indices are zero-based and cover the first 20 guided steps.
paragraphs.zh: 早期潜在状态噪声过大，无法可靠地进行流估计，因此我们在第0–5步禁用通道过滤，并将参考注入所有通道。 随着运动估计变得更加可靠，我们在第6–10步允许Wan2.1的16个通道中最多有两个保留原始预测；因此至少有14个通道继续接收参考。 在第11–19步期间，我们将该限制放宽到六个通道，让模型有更多自由度来恢复纹理，同时在其余通道中保持轨迹引导。 这些索引从零开始计数，涵盖前20个引导步骤。

sents.en: Early latent states are too noisy for reliable flow estimation, so we disable channel filtering and inject the reference into all channels during steps 0–5.

sents.en: As the motion estimates become more reliable, we allow at most two of Wan2.1’s 16 channels to retain the original prediction during steps 6–10; at least 14 channels therefore continue to receive the reference.
